name: omni-card
description: A browser card table for playing almost any card game with friends.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @omni/server" "npm run dev -w @omni/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @omni/client && npm run build -w @omni/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
